episodeTitle.en: Overcome imposter syndrome and accelerate your career | Julie Zhuo (Sundial, Facebook)
episodeTitle.zh: 克服冒名顶替综合症，加速职业发展 | 朱莉·卓（Sundial，Facebook）

guestBioOfficial.en: Julie Zhuo is the co-founder of Sundial, a company that helps builders make meaningful use of data to fulfill their mission. With over 400K followers across social media, she is one of the most influential leaders in product design, and product thinking broadly. Julie started her career at Facebook as a product designer and eventually led teams of 100+ designers as the VP of Design. Her experience leading at Facebook motivated her to publish the Wall Street Journal best seller The Making of a Manager in 2019. On the side, Julie shared her thoughts on technology, design, and leadership in The Looking Glass, the blog that inspired Lenny’s Newsletter.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 朱莉·卓是Sundial的联合创始人，该公司致力于帮助开发者有效利用数据实现使命。她在社交媒体上拥有超过40万粉丝，是产品设计和产品思维领域最具影响力的领导者之一。朱莉的职业生涯始于Facebook，担任产品设计师，最终以产品副总裁身份领导超过100名设计师团队。她在Facebook的领导经验促使她于2019年出版《经理人修炼之道》，登上《华尔街日报》畅销书榜单。此外，她还在博客《镜报》上分享对科技、设计和领导力的见解，该博客启发了Lenny’s Newsletter的创立。

title.en: Overcome imposter syndrome and accelerate your career | Julie Zhuo (Sundial, Facebook)
title.zh: 克服冒名顶替综合症，加速职业发展 | 朱莉·卓（Sundial，Facebook）

summary.en: In Lenny's very first episode, Julie shares hard-won career advice, from overcoming imposter syndrome to running effective product review meetings. She discusses what great design hiring and feedback look like, and how her immigrant background shaped her relentless work ethic. The conversation is a foundational primer on product leadership and personal growth.
summary.zh: 在 Lenny 的第一期节目中，朱莉分享了来之不易的职业建议，从克服冒名顶替综合征到如何开好产品评审会。她探讨了什么是优秀的设计招聘与反馈，以及移民背景如何塑造了她不懈的工作态度。本期堪称产品领导力与个人成长的入门基石。
